sn22.5:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
sn22.5:1.3: tatra kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi bhikkhavoti. bhadanteti te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ. bhagavā etadavoca:
sn22.5:1.7: rūpassa samudayañca atthagamañca, vedanāya samudayañca atthagamañca, saññāya samudayañca atthagamañca, saṅkhārānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca, viññāṇassa samudayañca atthagamañca.
sn22.5:2.1: ko ca bhikkhave, rūpassa samudayo, ko vedanāya samudayo, ko saññāya samudayo, ko saṅkhārānaṃ samudayo, ko viññāṇassa samudayo:
sn22.5:2.2: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
sn22.5:3.3: tassa rūpaṃ abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato uppajjati nandī.
sn22.5:4.1: vedanaṃ abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati. tassa vedanaṃ abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato uppajjati nandī. yā vedanāya nandī tadupādānaṃ. tassupādānapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā sambhavanti. evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti.
sn22.5:4.3: saṅkhāre abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati. tassa saṃkhāre abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato uppajjati nandī. yā saṅkhāresu nandī tadupādānaṃ. tassupādānapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā sambhavanti. evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti.
sn22.5:4.5: tassa viññāṇaṃ abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato uppajjati nandī.
sn22.5:6.1: ko ca bhikkhave, rūpassa atthagamo, ko vedanāya atthagamo,
sn22.5:7.1: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu nābhinandati nābhivadati nājjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
sn22.5:8.3: tassa rūpaṃ anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato yā rūpe nandī sā nirujjhati.
sn22.5:8.5: upādānanirodhā bhavanirodho, bhavanirodhā jātinirodho, jātinirodhā jarāmaraṇaṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā nirujjhanti.
sn22.5:9.2: tassa vedanaṃ anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato yā vedanāya nandī sā nirujjhati.
sn22.5:10.3: tassa saṅkhāre anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato yā saṅkhāresu nandī sā nirujjhati.
sn22.5:11.2: tassa viññāṇaṃ anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato yā viññāṇe nandi sā nirujjhati.
sn22.5:11.3: tassa nandinirodhā upādānanirodho, upādānanirodhā bhavanirodho, bhavanirodhā jātinirodho, jātinirodhā jarāmaraṇaṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā nirujjhanti.
sn22.5:12.1: ayaṃ bhikkhave, rūpassa atthagamo, ayaṃ vedanāya atthagamo, ayaṃ saññāya atthagamo, ayaṃ saṅkhārānaṃ atthagamo, ayaṃ viññāṇassa atthagamoti.
